**Summary**  
Patient C3L-00817 has a moderate GNN-A out-of-fold risk of 0.445 for stage III–IV ccRCC [pred:C3L-00817:gnn]. The risk splits 57.5% to tumor protein dysregulation and 42.5% to clinical comorbidities, chiefly hypertension [contrib:C3L-00817:HP:0000822]. The tumor drivers are predominantly *down*-regulated proteins: MYH14, TJP3, EPCAM, PGD, GRB14, PSMB6, ARHGAP23 [contrib:C3L-00817:NCBIGene:79784][contrib:C3L-00817:NCBIGene:27134][contrib:C3L-00817:NCBIGene:4072][contrib:C3L-00817:NCBIGene:5226][contrib:C3L-00817:NCBIGene:2888][contrib:C3L-00817:NCBIGene:5694][contrib:C3L-00817:NCBIGene:57636]. A somatic VHL frameshift (p.R79fs) [pt:C3L-00817:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:7428] and MTOR p.A1519V [pt:C3L-00817:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:2475] are present. Model-ranked genes point to immune/hematopoietic signaling (SH2B3, MPL, SYK, PIK3CG, FLT3) [rank:C3L-00817:gene:NCBIGene:10019][rank:C3L-00817:gene:NCBIGene:4352][rank:C3L-00817:gene:NCBIGene:6850][rank:C3L-00817:gene:NCBIGene:5294][rank:C3L-00817:gene:NCBIGene:2322]; model-ranked drugs are largely CGRP-pathway and immunomodulatory agents (fremanezumab, oprelvekin, galcanezumab, etanercept) [rank:C3L-00817:drug:DRUGBANK:DB14041][rank:C3L-00817:drug:DRUGBANK:DB00038][rank:C3L-00817:drug:DRUGBANK:DB14042][rank:C3L-00817:drug:DRUGBANK:DB00005], but these are cohort-relative model suggestions, not evidence-backed for ccRCC.
